name: Nemirazh
source:
The evening at school is so peaceful, since everyone went home a long time ago... At least, that's how it seems at first glance, although you still catch sight of late-staying students every now and then.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2824819178]Steam[/url]]
translation:
学校的夜晚是那么的平静，大家都已经回家了……至少乍一看是这样，虽然你还是时不时地看到迟到的学生。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2824819178]Steam[/url]]
